verdict.rationale: LobeHub publishes its own API reference material: a developer page pointing to the public REST API and its OpenAPI specification, a live openapi.json, and an @lobehub/sdk generated from that spec. Nothing in the evidence shows this reference is interactive (explorable or try-it-out) or comes with runnable examples. missing for 10: interactive API explorer, runnable/try-it examples, in-depth reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
